# Configuration

Ensemble has two configuration layers. The workspace file is human-editable and authoritative for workspace shape. Agent settings, dispatch limits, and UI state live in OpenCode plugin storage under `v2/meta` and are written through the validated service path.

## Workspace file: .ensemble/config.json

Path: `<workspace>/.ensemble/config.json`. `version` must be `1`. The workspace owns this file: Ensemble writes it on create, update, membership sync, and restore, and you may edit it directly. A missing file means the directory is not an Ensemble workspace.

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "id": "workspace_01JEXAMPLE",
  "name": "Acme Notes",
  "leader": "Nova",
  "members": [
    "Nova",
    "Sage"
  ],
  "synthesis": true,
  "paused": false
}
```

| Field | Required | Default | Owner and rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | yes | `1` | File format version. Must be `1`; any other value makes the file unreadable and the directory is ignored. |
| `id` | no | none | Optional workspace id hint used during discovery. It only wins when the id is free or already names this directory. |
| `name` | yes | none | Workspace name. Trimmed and required; authoritative over the stored workspace row. |
| `leader` | yes | none | Leader agent name. Must resolve to exactly one non-archived agent and must be in `members`. |
| `members` | yes | none | Member agent names. Trimmed, non-empty, case-insensitively unique, and each must resolve to one non-archived agent. |
| `synthesis` | no | `true` | Workspace synthesis toggle. Missing means `true`; only `false` disables it. |
| `paused` | no | `false` | Pause flag. Missing means `false`; `true` rejects new work. |

Extra fields are ignored. A wrong version, a missing name or leader, duplicate member names, or a name that does not resolve to exactly one active agent makes the file invalid. Discovery then ignores that directory; reconciliation keeps the last good state.

Editing while the service runs is reconciled on the maintenance timer. Reopen the workspace to force reconciliation.

## Stored settings

Settings are stored in the plugin storage row `v2/meta`, not in a repository file. Ensemble owns this row; `updateSettings()` is the validated write path, and the TUI Settings panel plus the `:native-first`, `:tools`, and `:limits` commands all use it. Do not hand-edit the storage row.

| Setting | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `maxActiveRuns` | `3` | Scheduler concurrency slots. Minimum `1`. No Settings row or `:` command at this version. |
| `maxDelegations` | `10` | Per-run fan-out cap, also used as the maximum skill count capped at 8. Minimum `1`. |
| `maxDepth` | `5` | Deprecated. Readable from older stores but ignored for enforcement; use `dispatchDepth`. |
| `synthesis` | `true` | Legacy stored boolean with no active consumer found in this release. Workspace `synthesis` in `config.json` is the live toggle. |
| `nativeFirst` | `on` | Native-first migration mode: `on`, `off`, or `shadow`. Absent or invalid resolves to `on`. |
| `nativeMentionRouting` | `true` | Mention-routing kill switch. `false` makes `$Name` a reference, appends a visible refusal, and forces the legacy tool surface. |
| `toolSurface` | unset | Explicit tool-surface override: `native` or `legacy`. Unset means the effective surface follows the migration mode; an explicit `legacy` survives `:native-first on`. |
| `dispatchGroupMaxHops` | `8` | Hops allowed inside one dispatch group (root or continuation). Captured by each new root group. |
| `dispatchCommandMaxHops` | `24` | Hops allowed for one command across every group. Must be at least the group budget and cover the continuation allowance. |
| `dispatchDepth` | `8` | Longest ancestor chain inside one group. |
| `dispatchContinuations` | `2` | Continuation groups one command may open. |

## Dispatch limits

The four dispatch values are validated as one set. New commands capture the current values; running groups keep the caps they already captured.

| Setting | Default | Allowed |
|---|---|---|
| `dispatchGroupMaxHops` | `8` | tiers 8, 16, 24 |
| `dispatchCommandMaxHops` | `24` | tiers 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48; at least group hops |
| `dispatchDepth` | `8` | 1–16 |
| `dispatchContinuations` | `2` | 0–5; each continuation needs at least an 8-hop group |

## Deprecated and unused fields

- `Settings.maxDepth` is deprecated. It remains readable for older stores and is ignored for enforcement; depth comes from `dispatchDepth`.
- `Settings.synthesis` is stored but has no active consumer in this release. The live synthesis toggle is the workspace `synthesis` field in `config.json`.
- `maxActiveRuns`, `maxDelegations`, and `maxDepth` have no Settings-panel row or dedicated `:` command at this version. They are stored settings writable through `settings.update`.
